title: Rabbi David Tawil: Shemuel II Chapters 22 & 23 - "Song of David & David's Warriors"

chapters.title: Introduction to the second half of Shira David
chapters.about: Structure and tone shift in David's song

chapters.title: Analysis of verses 30-32
chapters.about: God as a shield and the poetic structure

chapters.title: Connection to Chana
chapters.about: Parallels between David and Chana's prayers

chapters.title: Shift to an aggressive tone
chapters.about: David's transition from defensive to offensive

chapters.title: David's warriors
chapters.about: Introduction to the warriors in chapter 23

summary: Rabbi Tawil explores the second half of Shira David in Shemuel Bet chapter 22, analyzing how the tone shifts from defensive reliance on Hashem to an aggressive stance against foreign enemies. He also draws parallels between David's song and the prayer of Chana in Shemuel Alef, and begins an examination of the warriors listed in chapter 23.
questions: Why does the tone of David's song shift from defensive to aggressive?
How does David's song relate to the prayer of Chana?
What is the connection between Shira David and Tehillim 18?
Who were the warriors of David mentioned in chapter 23?
